# Muse & Silk

> A modern accessories house based in Pakistan, offering considered scarves, silk bandanas and eyewear. Nationwide delivery across Pakistan, with cash on delivery and bank deposit payment options.

Muse & Silk (also written Muse and Silk) sells three categories of accessories: silk scarves, bandanas, and eyewear (sunglasses). Every product page lists price in PKR, available colors/variants, stock status, and material/care details. Orders are confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before dispatch; cash-on-delivery orders are reserved for 12 hours and bank-deposit orders for 24 hours.
